preconditions.description: The number of crimes n must be between 0 and 10^18.
The number of conditions c must be between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(t, str) and len(t) == 1 and t.isupper() for t in crime_types)
preconditions.description: Each crime type must be a single uppercase Latin letter.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(m, int) and m > 0 for m in multiplicities)
preconditions.description: Each multiplicity must be a positive integer.
The product of all multiplicities must not exceed 123.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of different ways to commit exactly n crimes modulo 12345.
